scheme_name: Spectacles Scheme- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: The applicant must be a worker employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana
The worker must be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board
Monthly salary of the worker must not exceed ₹25,000
The worker must have a minimum service period of one year
Benefit is available only once every five years for each beneficiary
Application must be submitted within three months from the date of the bill after obtaining a doctor's prescription
The scheme is available to the worker or his/her dependents
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹1,500 for the purchase of spectacles for workers or their dependents, provided once every five years.
